Ravi P.: FYInoticed some bad invoices after yesterday's batch: a few customers received two PDFs with the same invoice_id and another set are missing the "support_fee" line entirely.
Hannah T.: Oof. Any sample invoice_ids?
Ravi P.: Samples: 2026-03-25-RD-3097 (duplicate PDF), 2026-03-25-RD-3102 (missing support_fee). Generated ~03:42-03:45 UTC.
Billing Bot: invoice-generator ERROR: s3_put_conflict invoice_id=2026-03-25-RD-3097 key=inv/2026/03/25/2026-03-25-RD-3097.pdf status=409
Marco S.: We saw a transient failure in reconciler where a reconcile job for partition p-224 retried and produced two outputs that both fed pdf-gen. Looks like job dedupe didn't catch the retry.
Nadia R.: The missing support_fee looks like the coupon-apply job ran after reconciler for some partitions. The reconciler snapshot didn't include waiver flags for those customers.
Hannah T.: Can we pause outgoing invoice emails and stop finalizing invoices until we dedupe and rerun?
Ravi P.: Billing Bot, set outbound_email_paused=true and auto_finalize=false for 60m.
Billing Bot: command accepted: outbound_email_paused=true auto_finalize=false (expires in 60m) :white_check_mark:
Marco S.: Quick remediation plan: 1) find duplicate S3 keys and remove the stale object 2) rerun pdf-gen for deduped invoice_ids 3) run a fixup to backfill support_fee line for invoices generated between 2026-03-25T03:30:00Z and 2026-03-25T03:50:00Z 4) re-enable finalization after verification.
Nadia R.: SQL to find missing support_fee: SELECT invoice_id FROM invoice_line_items WHERE line_code='support_fee' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-25T03:30:00Z' AND '2026-03-25T03:50:00Z' HAVING COUNT(*) = 0;
Ravi P.: I'll coordinate customer outreach drafts for affected customers and attach corrected PDFs + credit memos where duplicates went out.
Hannah T.: Also add a short-term alert: if pdf generator enqueues the same invoice_id twice within 2 minutes, fire PagerDuty.
Marco S.: PR to add idempotency token to reconciler outputs is up, will ship once CI passes (ETA 20m).
Nadia R.: I'll write the backfill script and run it in dry-run first.
Ravi P.: Thanks. Keep this thread updated. If anyone finds additional invoice_ids, paste them here.
Hannah T.: Noted. Will confirm after backfills and then authorize re-enable of emails. :thumbsup:
